# Approach

PURE FINANCIAL ADVISORS LLC has engaged us to design and implement an enhanced Lead-to-AUM (L2A) and Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC) reporting solution. This engagement will provide greater visibility into client acquisition journeys, optimize marketing spend, and empower data-driven decision-making across the organization. Our methodology centers on an iterative, collaborative process working closely with stakeholder teams to ensure accuracy, transparency, and alignment with business goals.

Our approach leverages best practices in modern data engineering and reporting on Microsoft Fabric and Azure Synapse platforms, focusing on batch-oriented, automated data pipelines. The project is structured into two distinct phases: Design (Phase 3A) and Build (Phase 3B). Each phase is sequenced to mitigate risks, manage dependencies (notably QuickBooks integration and data quality assessment), and accelerate the realization of value from upgraded Power BI dashboards and unified data models.

---

**Phase 3A: Solution Design, Duration: 3 weeks, Timeline: Week 1 to Week 3**  
**Summary:** Establish the blueprint for L2A and CAC data model, reporting logic, and technical solution architecture.

**Activities:**  
- Conduct discovery sessions to define L2A and CAC KPI requirements with Data, Technology, and Marketing stakeholders  
- Assess data sources (Salesforce, Tamarac, Azure Blob Storage, QuickBooks) for availability, structure, and quality  
- Design draft data model diagrams and transformation logic for L2A and CAC metrics  
- Develop Power BI report mock-ups (up to 8 views) to visualize target user experience and reporting flows  
- Complete a comprehensive Data Gap Assessment highlighting required integrations and dependencies  
- Prepare the Technical Approach and a detailed Phase 3B Implementation Plan  

---

**Phase 3B: Solution Build & Integration, Duration: 8–12 weeks, Timeline: Week 4 to Week 15**  
**Summary:** Build, integrate, and deploy the automated L2A and CAC reporting suite and Power BI dashboards.

**Activities:**  
- Configure and test automated data ingestion for all required sources, with emphasis on QuickBooks integration  
- Implement the L2A and CAC data model within Microsoft Fabric, including data transformation and aggregation pipelines  
- Develop and validate the Power BI reporting suite, ensuring clear KPI definitions and robust visual analytics  
- Execute data quality review and remediation in collaboration with business stakeholders  
- Integrate datasets and validate reporting outputs against agreed business logic  
- Provide enablement sessions for users on new dashboards and support cutover to production processes  

---

This phased approach ensures alignment with PURE FINANCIAL ADVISORS LLC’s business objectives, mitigates technical and data risks, and produces actionable deliverables on an accelerated, transparent schedule. By sequencing delivery from discovery through deployment, we ensure robust design foundations and operational stability for enhanced L2A and CAC analytics.
